notes.title: Game Launch Discount!!!!
notes.notes:
Kill Them With Cuteness is finally out! I've been working on this for a few months in my spare time and it's finally time to show it off to the world! 



I'm putting the game on sale for a week to celebrate the launch!



Hope y'all can check it out, thanks for reading!
